designRule: Course pages must teach through hierarchy, practice, evidence, and topic-specific visuals. Never use generic flat cannabis clip art as a teaching image.
lessonVisualRule: Render a visual only when it has a defined learning purpose, accurate alt text, a descriptive caption, and an approved asset URL. Missing visuals must never fall back to decorative icons or generic plant art.

visual.purpose: Teach the learner to identify multiple hazards in a real cultivation-room context and distinguish routine control from stop-work/escalation.
visual.brief: Photorealistic indoor cannabis cultivation aisle with realistic irrigation hose, wet-floor risk, powered equipment, ladder, hand tools, and clearly visible safe/unsafe conditions. Educational documentary lighting, no stylization, no decorative cannabis branding.
visual.alt: Photorealistic cultivation-room safety scene showing several realistic workplace hazards for learner identification.

visual.purpose: Show how task-specific PPE, a chemical label, and an SDS are used together before work begins.
visual.brief: Photorealistic technician at a clean cultivation workbench reviewing an SDS and product label beside task-appropriate gloves, eye protection, apron, and other PPE. Labels legible only where necessary; no invented regulatory text.
visual.alt: Technician reviewing a chemical label and safety data information beside task-specific PPE.

visual.purpose: Connect plant dust, CO2, heat, lighting, and respiratory exposure to real workplace controls and escalation.
visual.brief: Photorealistic commercial cultivation room with environmental monitoring, CO2 warning hardware, bright fixtures, plant-handling activity, and a worker observing posted safety controls. Scientifically plausible equipment and PPE.
visual.alt: Commercial cultivation room showing environmental and occupational exposure controls around workers and crop.

visual.purpose: Help learners visualize how people, carts, tools, hose ends, and plant material can carry contamination between zones.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation facility transition between quarantine and production zones with worker, cart, tools, hose, trays, and visible zone-control practices. Composition should make movement pathways visually understandable without cartoon arrows dominating.
visual.alt: Cultivation facility transition illustrating realistic contamination pathways between controlled zones.

visual.purpose: Show the difference between debris removal, cleaning, disinfection, contact time, and verification.
visual.brief: Photorealistic greenhouse or cultivation sanitation workstation showing a before/after workflow: debris removal, physically cleaned bench/tool, measured disinfectant preparation, application, and documented completion. Realistic tools and surfaces.
visual.alt: Sanitation workflow showing cleaning, disinfection, and verification steps in a cultivation work area.

visual.purpose: Teach containment logic when suspect material crosses a controlled boundary.
visual.brief: Photorealistic quarantine tray and labeled cart stopped at a controlled production boundary, with plant identity tags preserved and a technician documenting the event before movement. No dramatic hazard imagery.
visual.alt: Quarantined plant material stopped at a controlled boundary while identity and movement are documented.

visual.purpose: Show how a technician verifies the correct SOP/work order, revision, prerequisites, and acceptance criteria before a task.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation technician at a workstation comparing a current controlled SOP/work order on tablet or printed binder with task materials. Emphasize version check, checklist structure, and work context without fake readable microtext.
visual.alt: Cultivation technician verifying the current work instruction before beginning an assigned task.

visual.purpose: Differentiate operator-level action from maintenance, safety, and supervisor escalation.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation equipment fault scene with technician stopping at an access boundary while maintenance tools and electrical enclosure remain untouched. Supervisor/maintenance escalation context visible.
visual.alt: Technician recognizing an equipment condition that requires escalation rather than unauthorized repair.

visual.purpose: Teach documentation of actual conditions when work cannot be completed as written.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation work station with incomplete work order, observed deviation, tagged affected area, and technician documenting actual condition and escalation. Focus on evidence preservation and honest status.
visual.alt: Technician documenting a cultivation work deviation and unresolved task condition.

visual.purpose: Show continuity of plant, tag, room, batch, lot, and container identity during routine cultivation movement.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cannabis plants with realistic plant tags moving from bench to cart to designated room, with batch/lot identifiers preserved. Clean commercial cultivation environment; labels generic and non-jurisdiction-specific.
visual.alt: Tagged cannabis plants being moved while plant, batch, and room identity remain continuous.

visual.purpose: Connect physical plant movement with contemporaneous digital or paper records.
visual.brief: Photorealistic technician scanning or recording tagged plant movement while a cart and destination room are visible. Show physical count and digital record as two views of the same event without branding a specific seed-to-sale vendor.
visual.alt: Technician recording a tagged plant movement and inventory count during a physical transfer.

visual.purpose: Teach that mismatches are verified and escalated rather than silently forced to match records.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation inventory station showing a physical count that does not match a displayed record, with technician pausing and documenting discrepancy. Waste container can be present but no destruction procedure should be implied as universal.
visual.alt: Technician identifying and documenting a mismatch between physical cultivation inventory and the record.

visual.purpose: Teach systematic pre-use equipment inspection before cultivation work starts.
visual.brief: Photorealistic irrigation or cultivation equipment pre-use check with technician inspecting cleanliness, hose connections, guards where applicable, leaks, asset identification, and work area condition.
visual.alt: Technician performing a pre-use readiness inspection on cultivation equipment.

visual.purpose: Show the boundary of permitted operator care such as cleaning, emitter observation, filter inspection, and housekeeping.
visual.brief: Photorealistic irrigation bench or fertigation area with technician cleaning approved components, checking filter or emitter condition, and inspecting for leaks without opening restricted electrical/mechanical systems.
visual.alt: Technician performing routine authorized care and inspection on cultivation irrigation equipment.

visual.purpose: Teach what fault information should be captured before escalation.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation equipment alarm scene showing controller status, affected zone, visible leak or delivery issue, asset label, time context, and technician taking notes rather than guessing at repair.
visual.alt: Technician documenting alarm and fault context for cultivation equipment escalation.

visual.purpose: Show what complete, attributable, contemporaneous records look like at the point of work.
visual.brief: Photorealistic cultivation technician recording measurements and task completion at the work area with plant/room identifiers, timestamp, units, and correction history represented clearly but without invented proprietary software.
visual.alt: Technician creating contemporaneous cultivation records at the point of work.

visual.purpose: Show a structured handoff that communicates completed work, unresolved issues, deviations, and priorities.
visual.brief: Photorealistic shift handoff between two cultivation technicians or technician and lead, using a concise work log, room map, and current issue list in a commercial grow facility.
visual.alt: Two cultivation workers completing a structured shift handoff using current records and room information.

visual.purpose: Integrate hazard, sanitation, identity, inventory, equipment, and record decisions in one realistic shift context.
visual.brief: Photorealistic wide commercial cultivation-room workflow scene with work order, tagged plants, sanitation checkpoint, irrigation equipment, inventory movement, and documentation station represented coherently as one technician shift environment.
visual.alt: Integrated cultivation technician shift environment combining safety, sanitation, traceability, equipment, and documentation tasks.
